**EL-HAZ-1 Hazard warning**

Each press of the hazard warning button lasting at least 100 ms shall switch hazard warning on, or off.

While hazard warning is on, all four direction-indicator lamps (front and rear, left and right) shall flash together, whatever the turn stalk position, and both turn telltales in the cluster shall flash with them.

When hazard warning is switched off, direction indication shall resume on the side the turn stalk selects, or stop when the stalk is neutral.

description: Top-level requirement on ExteriorLightingDesign. It takes the hazard warning behaviour of UN R48 (all direction indicators operated together, with an operating telltale) and adds the push-push behaviour drivers expect from a latching hazard switch.
The 100 ms minimum press is the shortest press the 50 ms DriverCan0 cycle is sure to sample; a normal press lasts 150 to 300 ms.
